## About
BeStrong Chiropractic is a family chiropractic office in Mansfield, TX, owned and operated by Stephen Berndt D.C. Dr. Berndt did his undergrad studies at the University of Northern Iowa, where he was a pre-med major and a walk-on for the UNI Panthers football team. He earned his doctorate at Palmer College of Chiropractic in Davenport, Iowa.
Chiropractic is a natural form of health care. An adjustment applies a precise force to a specific part of the spinal segment to correct a misalignment. That permits normal nerve transmission and helps your body recuperate on its own, without drugs or surgery.
Alongside adjustments, the office offers Graston Technique, Active Release Techniques, Kinesio-Tape, Progressive Exercise Therapy, foam rolling, Therapeutic Ultrasound, Muscle/Interferential Stimulation, Moist Heat and Cryotherapy. The practice is rated 5 from 36 Google reviews.

## Services
- Chiropractic spinal adjustment: A precise force applied to a specific part of the spinal segment to correct misalignment and permit normal nerve transmission.
- Adjusting Techniques: Diversified, Gonstead, Thompson, Activator, Flexion-Distraction and Extremity adjusting, chosen to fit your specific needs.
- Active Release Techniques: Hands-on soft tissue therapy offered alongside your adjustments.
- Progressive Exercise Therapy: Exercise therapy that builds on your treatment plan as you recover.

## FAQ
Q: Who will I see?
A: Dr. Stephen Berndt, who owns and operates the practice. He earned his doctorate at Palmer College of Chiropractic in Davenport, Iowa.

Q: Can I come in on a Saturday?
A: Saturday is by appointment only. Please contact the office to set one up.

Q: Can I get in between my scheduled visits?
A: One patient wrote that when she needed an extra visit between scheduled appointments, Dr. Berndt was flexible and worked her in. Contact the office and ask.

Q: How do I request an appointment?
A: Use the request form on the contact page or email bestrongchiropractic@gmail.com. If needed, you will hear back within 48-72 hours.
